Overall verdict: needs_changes. Implementer target declaration is present and matches `{Repo: DontPanic, Env: dev, Project: (none)}`; I found no forbidden command shapes in their `target_context.commands_run`.

FINDING (high, correctness): Anthropic auth status is optimistic. Evidence: `config_inventory._anthropic_auth_configured()` treats `executors.get_executor("claude").is_available()` as auth, but `BaseExecutor.is_available()` only checks `shutil.which(self.cli_binary)`, so a machine with `claude` installed but not authenticated reports `secret_anthropic_auth=ok`. Recommendation: probe an actual authenticated Claude session or downgrade binary-only presence to non-ok/human-required.

FINDING (medium, correctness): the acceptance-listed `roles set` edit route is not a validated command surface. Evidence: inventory emits `dontpanic roles set <role> <executor>` in `dashboard_mutation_shape`, but `command_validation.validate_command_tokens(['roles','set','implementer','claude'])` returns `False` with “unknown subcommand 'roles'”. Recommendation: add a real `roles` spec to `command_validation` and test the filled command shape.

FINDING (low, style): changed F008 tests are not ruff-clean despite the implementer claim. Evidence: `ruff check --no-cache scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/config_inventory.py scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_config_inventory_f008.py` reports `I001` on the test import block. Recommendation: run ruff on al
